basis.FACTUAL_GROUNDING: Registry observations and numbers pass formal guard, but scenario invokes an unspecified prior/closed range lower boundary unavailable as verified price structure in input.
basis.EVIDENCE_RELEVANCE: Selected current price and aligned OI match horizon; conflict/participation limitations are acknowledged.
basis.HORIZON_CLARITY: Explicit future 4h relative to original market cutoff; historical simulation, not future from actual API invocation.
basis.FORWARD_HYPOTHESIS: 未来4h倾向为上行延续假设：4h价格与OI数量同向扩张，已结算Funding为负（空头支付多头）不构成多头拥挤证据；但1h OI收缩、24h区间高点回撤-1.02%及缺乏主动买卖量数据限制强度，故仅低置信。
basis.CONTRARY_EVIDENCE: OI contraction/short-window weakness and low participation described; LOW does not establish prediction edge.
basis.INVALIDATION_QUALITY: Existing same-horizon price opposite rule invalidates thesis; OI reversed rule only warns; not a structure stop.
basis.DIRECTION_COHERENCE: Weak bullish hypothesis is consistent with current upward price and acknowledged opposing evidence, no certainty.
basis.ACTIONABILITY: WAIT_FOR_PULLBACK is separated from bias; no direct setup or numeric entry, but unspecified range boundary makes scenario incompletely reproducible.
